classification.difficultyReason: Factor the input expression to determine a consistent order of horizontal compression and translation, then map the supplied intercepts to sketch the curve. The key decision is distinguishing the translation distance from the constant inside the unfactored input.

content.prompt:
The diagram shows $y=f(x)$.
First describe the transformations in $y=f(2x-1)$ and sketch the new curve.

spec.description: Qualitative upward-opening parabola with arrowed branches, intercepts labelled 1/2 and 1, and an unlabelled turning point below the x-axis. No grid or numeric vertical scale. Drawing coordinates control appearance only and do not supply a quadratic coefficient. House style uses black axes.
spec.mathematics: The x-intercepts are 1/2 and 1. The turning point lies midway between them at x=3/4; its ordinate is unspecified.

answer.short: Dilate horizontally by factor $\frac12$, then translate right by $\frac12$. Alternatively, translate right by $1$, then dilate horizontally by factor $\frac12$. The new curve has x-intercepts $\frac34$ and $1$ and its turning point at $x=\frac78$, with unchanged ordinate.
answer.worked:
$$\begin{aligned}y&=f(2x-1)\\y&=f\left(2\left(x-\frac12\right)\right)\end{aligned}$$
Dilate horizontally by factor $\frac12$, then translate right by $\frac12$.
Alternatively, translate right by $1$, then dilate horizontally by factor $\frac12$.
Each point $(x,y)$ maps to $\left(\frac{x}{2}+\frac12,y\right)$.
The x-intercepts become
$$\begin{aligned}x_1&=\frac{1/2}{2}+\frac12=\frac34\\x_2&=\frac{1}{2}+\frac12=1.\end{aligned}$$
The turning point moves from $x=\frac34$ to $x=\frac78$, with its ordinate unchanged. Sketch the same upward-opening curve compressed horizontally and shifted right, as shown.

spec.description: Complete solution graph obtained by applying the affine map x -> x/2 + 1/2 to every endpoint and control point of the supplied qualitative curve. No numeric vertical scale is introduced.
spec.mathematics: Transformed intercepts are 3/4 and 1. The vertex has x-coordinate 7/8 and unchanged unspecified ordinate.
